let rec helper (lst : List Nat) : Nat :=
    match lst with
    | [] => 0  -- technically shouldn't happen if input is always non-empty
    | [x] => x
    | x :: xs =>
      let maxTail := helper xs
      if x > maxTail then maxTail else x

  helper lst
